title: American-Style Mexican Noodle Soup
description: A creamy and spicy noodle soup with a hint of American influence. Inspired by Mexican cuisine, this dish is sure to warm your belly and soul.

ingredients.name: mildly spicy chorizo sausage
ingredients.notes: Can substitute with other sausage of choice

ingredients.name: narutomaki noodles
ingredients.notes: Can substitute with other noodles of choice

ingredients.name: mustardy cumin
ingredients.notes: Mix with chili powder for extra flavor

ingredients.name: chicken broth
ingredients.notes: Low sodium or homemade broth recommended

instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Add sliced chorizo sausage and cook until browned.
Add diced onion, bell pepper, and jalapeño, cooking until tender.
Add diced sweet potatoes, cumin, and chili powder, cooking for 5 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes or until sweet potatoes are tender.
Cook narutomaki noodles according to package instructions.
Stir in sour cream and shredded cheese (if using).
Serve soup hot, garnished with chopped cilantro (if desired).
Top with additional sour cream, cheese, and cilantro (if desired).
